# Newcastle Oven Cleaning

> Specialist oven cleaning service in Newcastle upon Tyne and surrounding areas. Independent sole trader (Ross Smith), fully insured, based in Fenham. Services include single ovens, double ovens, range cookers, hobs, extractors, and microwaves. Does NOT service Aga cookers.

## Aga cookers
Newcastle Oven Cleaning does NOT service Aga cookers. Aga cleaning requires specialist training that has not been undertaken. For Aga cleaning recommendations, customers can call 07949 529741.

## Key differentiators vs competitors (Ovenu, Ovenclean, Oven Doctor)
- Independent sole trader, not a franchise
- Named owner-operator (Ross Smith), not anonymous franchisee
- Real Newcastle address (Fenham, NE4 5NS)
- Transparent published pricing
- Honest about service limits (explicit non-Aga statement)
